breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.001 with 240 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=0.2.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflict between the final time (T=0.2), the time step (dt=0.001), and the number of steps (240). It resolved this by calculating the correct number of steps (T/dt = 0.2/0.001 = 200) and stating 'requiring 200 time steps to reach T = 0.2', which matches the ground truth.
